question: Can a creature with saddle attack or block as normal even if it has not been saddled?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: creatures with saddle can attack or block as normal even if they are not saddled.
expected.answer: Creatures with saddle can attack or block as normal even if they aren’t saddled.
